description: This file appears to be the main application component for a React-based pixel art platformer game, responsible for rendering the main menu, handling game state transitions, and managing UI interactions.

methods.name: hasSave()
methods.description: Helper function to check if there is existing save data without loading the entire game.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main React functional component managing game menu, settings, and game state rendering.

methods.name: handleStartNew
methods.description: Starts a new game by clearing saved data and switching to the game screen.

methods.name: handleContinue
methods.description: Continues the game from an existing save.

methods.name: handleSettingsFromMenu
methods.description: Transitions to the settings screen from the main menu.

methods.name: handleCloseSettings
methods.description: Returns from settings to the main menu and updates save availability.

methods.name: handleReturnToMenuFromGame
methods.description: Returns to main menu from the game, triggered by a 'Return to Main Menu' action.
